invariant_text: Every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests.

note: This is one of product-goal.yaml's own completion invariants, separate from the 10-item gate list (installed-wheel, independent-oracle, corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility, performance, reproducible-build).
